list.name: Postgres start

target.expr: {container_name="wojtus-postgres"} |= "database system is ready to accept connections"

description: Gateway event ingest of the WojtusDiscord bot: volume and handler time per event type, failures, database write gaps, gateway connection, backfill and health checks. Job wojtusdiscord.
title: WojtusDiscord / Events & Ingest

options.content: **What does the bot ingest, how fast, and what fails?** Pick event types at the top left; totals cover the time range.

panels.title: Events

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Gateway events in the range, selected event types. Counts include the first sample of a new series, which increase() and rate() miss: the bot creates a counter series on its first increment.

panels.title: Failed events

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Events with at least one failed handler in the range.

panels.title: Serialization failures

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="serialization_failed"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Events stored with a fallback payload because the serializer failed. The handlers still ran.

panels.title: Dead letters

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_event_dead_letters_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Failures the database refused, written to the JSONL fallback file in the range.

panels.title: Handler p95

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le)(rate(wojtus_event_handler_duration_seconds_bucket{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",event_type!~"GuildCreated|GuildMembersChunked|ThreadListSynced"}[$__range])))

panels.description: 95th percentile of the time an event spends in the pipeline, over the range. Without the event types that arrive only when the bot connects (GuildCreated, GuildMembersChunked, ThreadListSynced): one guild replay of 250 to 500 ms at a start was the whole p95 of a quiet night. 'Handler p95 by type' below shows them.

panels.title: Failed share

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type",outcome="failed"} + 0))[$__range:1m])) / sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Failed events as a share of all events in the range.

panels.title: Events per minute by type

targets.expr: sum by (event_type)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__interval:1m])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: Gateway events by event type, all outcomes. The legend sorts by total. Counts include the first sample of a new series, which increase() and rate() miss: the bot creates a counter series on its first increment.

panels.title: Events per minute by outcome

panels.description: One outcome per event: ok, failed (a handler threw) or serialization_failed.

panels.title: Events by type

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (event_type)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m])))

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (event_type)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m])) / scalar(sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_events_total{job="wojtusdiscord",event_type=~"$event_type"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))))

defaults.noValue: No samples in this time range

panels.description: 95th percentile of the JSON size stored in raw_event_logs, over the range. Buckets end at 1 MiB.

panels.title: Messages

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__range:1m]))

panels.description: Guild messages created in the range, counted from the event itself: a message whose database write fails still counts. Not filtered by the event type picker. Counts include the first sample of a new series, which increase() and rate() miss: the bot creates a counter series on its first increment.

panels.title: From humans

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord",author="human"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord",author="human"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord",author="human"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord",author="human"} + 0))[$__range:1m])) / (sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__range:1m])) > 0)

panels.description: Share of the messages in the range that a person wrote. The rest are bots, this bot included.

panels.title: Replies

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord",reply="true"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord",reply="true"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord",reply="true"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord",reply="true"} + 0))[$__range:1m])) / (sum(sum_over_time(((wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__range:1m])) > 0)

panels.description: Share of the messages in the range that reply to another message.

panels.title: With an attachment

panels.description: Share of the messages in the range with at least one attachment.

panels.title: Mean length

targets.expr: sum by (kind)(sum_over_time(((wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} - (((last_over_time(wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} > 660)) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} offset 1m and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_uptime_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} <= 660))) and on (job, instance) (wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"} == last_over_time(wojtus_process_start_time_seconds{job="wojtusdiscord"}[10m] offset 1m))) >= 0) or (wojtus_messages_total{job="wojtusdiscord"} + 0))[$__interval:1m])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)
